The company operates the part-time job site 'Baitoru', the spot part-time job service 'Spot Baitoru', the full-time and contract job site 'Baitoru NEXT', the general job site 'Hatarakonet', the professional job site 'Baitoru PRO', the nurse placement service 'Nurse de Hatarako', and the caregiver placement service 'Kaigo de Hatarako'.
